top_signals.title: Saudis Tell OPEC That Output Slumped Again to Lowest Since 1990
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia reported to OPEC that its crude oil production plunged again last month, hitting the lowest since 1990 as renewed hostilities between the US and Iran squeezed the kingdom’s export routes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Oil Breaks $100—and This Rally Has Legs
top_signals.summary: For months, crude oil prices have been constrained by reports of improving tanker traffic in the Strait of Hormuz. Even after the June ceasefire between Iran and the United States collapsed, tankers moving in and out of Hormuz have been moving at rates higher than in the spring. This has now changed with the latest escalation in the chokepoint, sending Brent crude above $100 per barrel on Wednesday morning. For months, analysts have been warning that Brent crude could surge to over $100 per barrel and stay there for an extended period of time.…

top_signals.title: Qatar in Talks to Buy US LNG With Specter of Lengthy War Looming
top_signals.summary: Qatar is in discussions to buy liquefied natural gas from US suppliers under long-term agreements as the Iran war has crippled its ability to supply its own customers, according to people familiar with the matter.
